shared_elements: rock-carved/relief imagery on a rough stone surface
repeated small marks arranged in rows
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures amid repeated small marks on a rock face, but that is nearly all they share: A shows a densely packed relief scene of costumed, seated/kneeling figures with elaborate headdresses beneath blocks of square glyph-like signs, arranged in registers, while B shows sparse, stick-like schematic figures and numerous crescent boats with rows of crew strokes scattered over open rock. The modelled, overlapping, high-relief naturalism with ornate attributes in A is entirely unlike the flat, linear, outline-only silhouettes of B, and the boat motif central to B has no counterpart in A.
